title: Secure customer invoice mutations and serialize receipt funding evidence
description: Stage3 core finance closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Require current enabled identity, existing sales-order module permission and authoritative customer scope on every customer invoice route before reads/counts/candidates/preview/write. Check stored and proposed customer, all linked sales orders and explicit trade document ownership; mixed customer sources require every relevant customer allowed. Restrict commercial invoice candidates through existing authoritative trade-document/loading participant scope, no new grants or guessed source. Denied edit or allocation replacement preserves original evidence and audit; preserve historical unavailable sources explicitly without exposing unauthorized fields.

Serialize invoice edit/record/void/order allocation replacement and receipt-to-invoice assignment/void under a compatible documented global sales-order/receipt/invoice lock order; audit callers to avoid inversion. Revalidate authoritative status and same-currency invoice/order capacity under locks. Distinct receipts cannot overfund the same invoice and concurrent invoices cannot exceed source sales-order amount. Reuse receipt lifecycle protection and existing allocations; keep original void history, explicit reason, shared customer/agency funding conventions and frozen recorded evidence. Actual SQL two independent connection assignment vs invoice void, distinct receipt assignments, edit vs record, replacement vs record and invoice order-capacity races plus live own/foreign/mixed/revoked/disabled denial. No tax service, bank action, accounting, stock posting or schema; run relevant unit and safe Release verification, browser evidence or accurate blocker.
